description:
#### **Job Title:** **Human Resources – Talent Acquisition specialist (Hotel Industry)**

* Internship
* Fresher
* Junior
* Senior

#### **Job Brief: Human Resources –** **Talent acquisition specialist** **(recruitment)**

* We are looking for Human resources – talent acquisition executive, recruiter, from hotel/restaurant industry who can handle talent acquisition (recruitment) responsibilities.
* A Talent Acquisition Specialist is responsible for sourcing, attracting, and hiring top talent to fill various roles within the organisation, from entry-level to managerial positions.
* This position focuses on understanding the unique needs of the outlets, finding the best-fit candidates, and promoting a strong employer brand to attract and retain quality employees.
* The Talent Acquisition Specialist plays an essential role in helping the organisation attract quality talent, contributing to its success and positive guest experience by maintaining a skilled and motivated workforce.

#### **Department:**

* Operations – Human Resources

**Job Type:**

* Full time
* Part time

**Type of Company:** **Hotel Industry**

* Hotels & Resorts
* Restaurants & Bars

**Work mode:**

* Hybrid

* **Note:**

* We do not have complete work from home option.
* Hybrid mode of work means: Work from office (minimum two days a week) – work from home – as per the requirement.
* Hybrid mode of work can be changed to full time work from office as per the work requirement.

**Work Location:**

* MBP, Mahape, Navi Mumbai

**Interview Location:**

* MBP, Mahape, Navi Mumbai

**Shift Timings:**

* 10.00 AM to 07.00 PM

**Working:**

* 5 days working
* 2 day Holiday
* Rotational Holidays

**Experience:**

* Minimum – Intern / Fresher
* Maximum – Up to 9 years of experience as human resources – talent acquisition specialist from hotel/restaurant industry can apply.

* **Note:**

* Candidate having relevant experience from hotel industry would be considered.

**Salary slab:**

* Internship – Rs.120,000/- Per annum (CTC / Fix + Variable = 80:20 ration)
* Fresher – Rs.180,000/- Per annum (CTC / Fix + Variable = 80:20 ration)
* Experience – up to Rs.900,000/- Per annum (CTC / Fix + Variable = 80:20 ration)

* **Note:**

* Salary structure: Fix + Variable (80:20 ratio).
* Candidates applying for the above post should be compulsory target oriented, as offered salary will be target oriented.
* Candidates applying for the above post should have their own laptop, good internet connection.
* Some weekend or evening work may be required depending on recruitment events or urgent hiring needs.

**Education qualification:**

* HR certification (e.g., PHR, SHRM-CP).
* Knowledge of industry-specific roles, including back-of-house (e.g., cooks, dishwashers) and front-of-house (e.g., servers, hosts) positions.
* Experience in a high-volume, fast-paced environment such as the restaurant industry.
* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, hotel management or related field.
* Master of Business Administration in HR/Management/Hospitality
* Diploma / Graduate in Travel and tourism (any related certification would be added benefit)
* BHM – Bachelor of Hotel Management (any related certification would be added benefit)

**Job Description:**

The Talent Acquisition Specialist will lead the recruitment process for the outlets, ensuring that all hiring needs are met efficiently and effectively. They work closely with hiring managers to understand staffing requirements, utilise creative sourcing methods to attract candidates, and ensure a seamless onboarding experience for new hires. This role requires deep knowledge of the hospitality industry, a strong network of talent, and the ability to promote a positive brand image.

**Duties & Responsibilities**

* Recruitment Strategy and Planning

* Sourcing and Candidate Attraction

* Candidate Screening and Selection

* Employer Branding

* Onboarding and Orientation

* Compliance and Record-Keeping

* Data Analysis and Reporting

* Relationship Management

**Key Responsibilities**:

**Recruitment Strategy and Planning:**

* Develop and implement recruitment strategies tailored to the restaurant industry, with a focus on attracting quality candidates for both front-of-house and back-of-house positions.
* Collaborate with managers to forecast staffing needs, considering seasonal trends and business growth.
* Analyse hiring trends and adjust recruitment strategies to meet changing demands.

**Sourcing and Candidate Attraction:**

* Utilise various sourcing channels, including job boards, social media, career fairs, community events, and employee referrals to reach diverse candidate pools.
* Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified candidates for high-turnover positions typical in the hospitality industry, such as servers, cooks, hosts, waiters, front desk, housekeeping, kitchen staff, etc.
* Foster relationships with local culinary schools, hospitality programs, and industry associations to attract talent.

**Candidate Screening and Selection:**

* Review resumes, conduct initial screenings, and shortlist candidates based on qualifications and fit for the environment.
* Schedule and conduct interviews, assess technical skills, cultural fit, and customer service orientation.
* Collaborate with hiring managers on final candidate selection, considering both operational needs and team dynamics.

**Employer Branding:**

* Promote the brand to position it as an employer of choice in the industry.
* Work with marketing or HR teams to create engaging job advertisements and content for social media that showcases the restaurant’s work culture, growth opportunities, and employee benefits.
* Represent the restaurant at career fairs, industry events, and community gatherings to boost brand visibility and attract talent.

**Onboarding and Orientation:**

* Coordinate with the HR and operations teams to ensure a smooth onboarding process for new hires, including orientation and training.
* Develop onboarding materials that familiarise new employees with the organisation culture, standards, and expectations.
* Gather feedback from new hires to improve the onboarding process continually.

**Compliance and Record-Keeping:**

* Ensure all hiring practices comply with local, state, and federal employment laws, including EEO, FMLA, and ADA.
* Maintain accurate records of candidates, job postings, and interviews in the applicant tracking system (ATS).
* Handle candidate background checks, references, and pre-employment verifications as needed.

**Data Analysis and Reporting:**

* Track and analyse key recruitment metrics, such as time-to-hire, cost-per-hire, and candidate sources.
* Provide regular reports to HR management on recruiting performance, trends, and areas for improvement.
* Use data to optimise recruitment strategies and reduce turnover rates.

**Relationship Management:**

* Build and maintain relationships with hiring managers and other leaders to stay informed on departmental needs.
* Serve as a point of contact for candidates throughout the hiring process, ensuring clear communication and a positive candidate experience.
* Develop partnerships with staffing agencies and recruitment vendors as necessary for high-volume hiring.

**Key Competencies:**

* **Proactivity**: Ability to anticipate hiring needs and act quickly to build a talent pool.
* **Creativity**: Develop innovative sourcing methods to attract candidates in a competitive market.
* **Resilience**: Able to handle high-volume recruiting demands and manage multiple roles simultaneously.
* **Customer Service Orientation**: Focused on delivering a positive experience for both candidates and internal stakeholders.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

**Key Skills:**

* Good knowledge and understanding about staff requirements.

* Good knowledge and understanding of recruitment.

* Well-organised and detail-oriented.

* Must be able to multi-task and take instruction from many sources.

* Strong interpersonal skills

* Positive attitude.

* Target oriented

* Presentable Personality

* Attention to detail

* Marketing skills

* Communication skills

* Relationship building skills

* Multitasking skills

* Time management skills

* Patience

* Listening skills

**Core Skills:**

* Knowledge of employment laws and best practices in recruitment and selection.
* Knowledge of human resources procedures

* Ability to operate office equipment (fax, copier, mail, etc.)

* Human resources Recruitment experience

* Ability to type at least 40 words per minute

* Proficient in proofreading, spelling, grammar punctuation and math

**Advanced Skills:**

* Knowledge of lead generation

* Proficient with data management

* Familiarity with social media

**Creative Skills:**

* Excellent verbal & written communication skills.

* Excellent grasp of English language.

* Creative & innovative thinker & planner.

**Management Skills:**

* Ability to work both independently & as an active member of a team.

* Able to prioritise, & manage time efficiently.

* Managing different projects simultaneously & working with strict deadlines.

* Self-motivated & self-directed.

**IT Skills:**

* Expertise in word processing, database, and spreadsheet software, including Microsoft office suite (Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, & Excel) & Google Docs.
* Ability to learn new and updated software
* Familiarity with recruiting software and applicant tracking systems (ATS).

description:
The **Contract Technical Recruiter** is responsible for managing the full-cycle recruitment process for technical roles, from sourcing and screening candidates to extending offers and onboarding new hires.

  
  

This role partners closely with hiring managers and technical teams to develop and implement strategic hiring plans, ensuring the attraction and retention of top-tier talent.

  
  

The ideal candidate has a strong ability to identify and engage passive candidates, assess technical skills, and deliver an exceptional candidate experience while supporting the company’s growth objectives.

  
  

Must work onsite at our **Whitefield, Bangalore, India WEX Office**.

  
  

This is a **Contract to Full time** opportunity, based on performance.

  
  

**Key Behavioral Attributes for Success:**

  
  

* **Strategic Partnership & Influencing:** Act as a true talent advisor who builds high-trust relationships with hiring managers, candidates, and cross-functional teams. You bring a strong sense of urgency, excellent negotiation and communication skills, and the ability to influence hiring decisions without formal authority.
* **Deep Technical Talent Craft:** Stay ahead of industry trends and possess a sharp understanding of complex technical roles and skill sets. You leverage exceptional sourcing capabilities (including advanced Boolean search, Ai and LinkedIn Recruiter) to identify top-tier talent, thoroughly assessing both technical competencies and cultural alignment while maintaining strict adherence to employment laws and equitable hiring practices.
* **Operational Rigor & Systems Savvy:** Drive efficient, high-volume recruitment cycles with superior organizational skills. You are fluent across modern recruitment stacks—including ATS and CRM platforms—and take a self-directed, structured approach to managing multiple requisitions seamlessly without letting candidate experience or pipeline data slip.
  

  
  

**How you'll make an impact:**

  
  

**Recruitment Strategy & Execution:**

* Partner with hiring managers and technical teams to understand talent needs and develop targeted recruitment strategies for the Bangalore market.
* Develop and maintain a robust talent pipeline for current and future technical hiring needs.
* Utilize data-driven insights to optimize recruitment processes and improve time-to-hire metrics.
  

  

**Sourcing & Talent Engagement:**

* Leverage various sourcing methods, including LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, social media, professional networks, and employee referrals, to identify top technical talent.
* Engage passive candidates through strategic outreach, networking, and relationship-building efforts.
* Maintain a strong understanding of the competitive landscape and industry trends to attract high-caliber candidates.
  

  

**Screening & Interviewing:**

* Review resumes and conduct initial phone screenings to assess technical and cultural fit.
* Coordinate and facilitate interviews, ensuring a seamless process for both candidates and hiring teams.
* Implement structured interviewing techniques to evaluate technical skills, problem-solving abilities, and alignment with company culture.
  

  

**Selection & Offer Management:**

* Partner with hiring managers to make informed hiring decisions based on interview feedback and technical assessments.
* Negotiate competitive offers and manage the offer extension process while ensuring alignment with internal compensation structures.
* Work closely with HR and hiring managers to drive a smooth onboarding experience for new hires.
  

  

**Candidate Experience & Employer Branding:**

* Provide a high-touch, transparent, and engaging candidate experience throughout the recruitment process.
* Champion the company’s employer brand by showcasing its culture, values, and career growth opportunities.
* Participate in employer branding initiatives, such as hosting or attending tech meetups, career fairs, and networking events.
  

  

**Process Improvement & Compliance:**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date candidate records in the applicant tracking system (ATS - Workday & CRM - Phenom).
* Ensure compliance with employment laws, regulations, and company policies throughout the hiring process.
* Continuously improve recruiting processes and leverage technology to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
  

  

**Education & Experience required:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5+ years of experience in full-cycle technical recruitment, preferably in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
* Experience recruiting for software engineering, AI/ML Engineers, Data Science, IT infrastructure, or other technical roles is strongly preferred.
* Showcase our Behavioral Attributes successfully.

description:
Req ID: 64332

Job Function: Strategy, Transformation & Business Intelligence

Posting Start Date: 06/11/2026

Posting End Date: 12/11/2026

Division: Digital

Job Location: IND-Bengaluru-RMZ Ecoworld

Advertised Salary: Competitive

**Recruiter: Sowmya Reddy**

**Hiring Manager: Amy Hunt**

**Career Grade: D**

**About the role**
------------------

The Portfolio Lead: PMO Specialist is the operational partner to Product, Engineering and Delivery leadership for an assigned portfolio. The role turns strategic priorities and roadmaps into realistic, funded and measurable delivery plans, giving leaders confidence that commitments are achievable, sustainable and focused on value.
  
The role connects Portfolio planning, Financial management, FinOps, Workforce and capacity, Delivery insight, Governance, Dependencies, Quality and continuous improvement. It provides a trusted view of portfolio health and supports timely, evidence-based decisions.
  
Although embedded within a portfolio, the role operates as part of the wider Delivery Operations and PMO community. It adopts common BT standards, tooling, data definitions and governance approaches, and contributes learning back into the community rather than creating local practices in isolation.

**What you’ll be doing**
------------------------

**Portfolio planning and strategic alignment**

* Partner with Product Managers, Engineering Leaders and Delivery Leads to translate strategic objectives and roadmaps into executable portfolio plans.
* Coordinate quarterly, monthly and ongoing portfolio planning, integrating demand, capacity, funding, dependencies and delivery readiness.
* Provide scenario analysis and recommendations to support prioritisation, sequencing and investment trade-offs.
* Maintain an evidence-based view of commitments, milestones, outcomes and delivery confidence.
* Provide complete, timely and evidence-based portfolio inputs into unit-level planning, reporting and assurance, using agreed definitions, standards and reporting cycles.
  

**Financial Insight, Investment Traceability and FinOps**

* Maintain an integrated view of portfolio investment, financial forecasts and actual expenditure, using Finance-owned information to connect financial performance with delivery progress and expected outcomes.
* Embed FinOps practices so cloud cost, consumption and value are considered in planning, prioritisation and delivery decisions.
* Monitor material cost trends, forecast variance, commitments and optimisation opportunities, ensuring accountable owners understand the insight and act.
* Coordinate reviews and follow-up where expenditure or forecast performance is outside agreed expectations.
* Ensure new demand, proofs of concept and material scope changes identify funding, cloud-cost implications and ongoing run-cost impact before commitment.
* Support consistent cost allocation, tagging, chargeback and showback, escalating data-quality or ownership gaps.
  

**Delivery performance, insight and forecasting**

* Establish measures covering outcomes, value, predictability, flow, quality and delivery health.
* Turn complex portfolio data into concise insight, options and recommendations for senior decision-makers.
* Maintain delivery forecasts and identify trends, constraints and opportunities early.
* Focus reporting on changes, exceptions, risks, decisions and outcomes rather than routine activity.
  

**Capacity, workforce and partner planning**

* Maintain a portfolio view of demand, capacity, skills and constraints across employees, partners and suppliers.
* Coordinate capacity and scenario planning to identify gaps, bottlenecks and required interventions.
* Facilitate prioritisation when demand exceeds capacity and provide forward-looking workforce insight.
  

**Risk, dependency, quality and assurance**

* Coordinate cross-team, cross-programme and cross-portfolio risks, issues and dependencies.
* Work with accountable owners on mitigation, resolution and escalation.
* Provide proportionate assurance that plans are realistic, funded, governed and supported by delivery evidence.
* Champion quality through visibility of technical debt, defects, rework, reliability and operational readiness.
  

**PMO standards, governance and tooling**

* Operate as a member of the wider Delivery Operations and PMO community, not as a standalone portfolio function.
* Apply agreed BT delivery standards, PMO controls, planning methods, data definitions, governance cadences and reporting practices.
* Maintain a single source of truth for commitments, milestones, dependencies, risks, financial insight and delivery confidence using agreed tooling.
* Design proportionate governance that provides transparency and control without unnecessary overhead.
* Share learning, support peer assurance and improve consistency across portfolios.

**Essential Skills / Experience**
---------------------------------

* **Commercial thinker** : Connects delivery choices to investment, cost, consumption, value and sustainable outcomes.
* **Portfolio planning** : Integrates strategy, demand, funding, capacity and dependencies into realistic scenarios.

The Data 360 & Visualization Platform Operations team keeps the platforms that run Salesforce's own business running. We are Customer Zero: we run these products at enterprise scale first, and what we learn goes back to the product teams.

* **Keep it up.** Monitoring, alerting, and frontline incident response that catch problems before customers do.
* **Make it stable.** Root-cause analysis of recurring failures, plus closing security and compliance findings.
* **Run it well.** Cataloging supported assets, tracking run costs, and keeping practices consistent.
* **Make it easy to get help.** One clear way to ask for support, backed by automation and AI agents.
* **Be Customer Zero.** Regular performance reviews, with the evidence fed to product and engineering.

**What it's like to join at this level:** You'll be a trusted operator on a team that is rebuilding how it works. You already know how to run production; here you'll take the hardest recurring problems, own them to root cause, and turn what you learn into runbooks, monitors, and automation the whole team uses. You'll manage escalations and support processes with guidance from senior leads, and you'll help the analysts around you get better.
  
**Who thrives here:** You're curious, you want to know why something happened, and you stay calm when something breaks. You can explain technical issues clearly to non-technical people, and you leave every system a little better documented and a little more automated than you found it.

**What Are We Looking For?**
============================

As a Senior Systems Analyst, Data Foundations, you'll independently own production support and administration for Salesforce's enterprise data and analytics platforms, with a strong grasp of native platform functionality and best practices. You'll help the team respond faster and resolve issues sooner, and you'll keep an eye on how satisfied our customers and partners are. You'll manage escalations across teams and time zones, act as a frontline responder who swarms incidents and knows when to pull in reliability engineers, own root-cause analysis through to resolution, and design monitoring that gives early warning. You'll shape lightweight support processes and reference material, and mentor analysts. You are an individual contributor and a go-to expert for your platform area.

**Escalation Management & Incident Response**

* Be the escalation point for Tier-2 analysts on complex cases and investigations.
* Be a frontline responder in incidents: connect first, assess impact, and use judgment on when to pull in Site Reliability Engineers (SREs). Manage the case, intake, and stakeholder communication workstream alongside Incident Command. SREs own incident resolution.
* Meet individual and team lifecycle SLAs: First Response Time (FRT), Next Response Time (NRT), and Average Resolution Time (ART), and case satisfaction (CSAT) targets while keeping backlog health. You are measured against the same targets as the team.

* Troubleshoot complex declarative and low-code issues, and recommend code-level fixes to engineering partners.

**Reliability & Observability**

* Use automation and AI to reduce manual work and move the team toward self-healing operations.

* Design BTS systems including ICT, AV, Security, ELV, Telecommunications, Wi-Fi, DAS, ANPR, Intercom, Visitor Management, Parking Guidance Systems, Smart Building, Digital Signage, IPTV, and Unified Communications systems.

* Develop layouts, riser diagrams, network topology diagrams, system schematics, rack elevations, cabinet layouts, equipment schedules, and detailed installation details.
* Perform system sizing calculations, bandwidth analysis, storage calculations, fiber backbone sizing, PoE/UPOE calculations, wireless capacity assessments, and security system loading calculations.
* Prepare technical specifications, Basis of Design (BoD) reports, design narratives, calculations, and authority submission documents.
* Design structured cabling systems in accordance with ANSI/TIA, ISO/IEC, and BICSI standards.

* Develop telecommunications containment systems, cable pathways, tray routing, conduit systems, and telecommunications spaces.
* Coordinate DAS, cellular coverage systems, GPON/XGS-PON networks, and fiber optic backbone infrastructure.
* Coordinate smart building integrations with BMS, IoT platforms, occupancy systems, room booking systems, and building analytics platforms.
* Ensure compliance with ANSI/TIA, ISO/IEC, BICSI, NFPA, IEEE, Uptime Institute, local authority requirements, telecom operator requirements, and client design standards.

* Attend design reviews, BIM coordination workshops, clash detection meetings, and client presentations.
* Review drawings, technical submissions, RFIs, method statements, and contractor proposals.
* Support authority approvals and telecom service provider coordination.
* Identify technical risks, space constraints, constructability issues, operational impacts, and maintenance concerns while proposing practical solutions.
* Support multidisciplinary coordination for large-scale mixed-use developments, hospitality projects, healthcare facilities, airports, smart cities, and data centres.

Documentation & Quality

* Prepare reports, narratives, technical specifications, schedules, calculations, and compliance matrices.

title: Human Resources Business Partner Manager - India
description:
**Who we are looking for**

The Human Resources Business Partner Manager leads and facilitates all HR people programs and strategies to support the needs of their assigned line of business through collaboration with the clients, HR specialty teams and other HR business partners. This role will serve as an expert consultant to Optiv’s India entity and consult with leaders on all talent matters, including talent reviews, organizational effectiveness, leader effectiveness, change management, organizational design and career pathways.

**How you’ll make an impact**

  

* Primary strategic HR partner to the India professional services function developing people strategies, performance analytics, needs assessments and resulting HR solutions.
* Establishes and maintains an intimate understanding of the client organizations and the business, in the interest of building effective and productive working relationships with internal stakeholders and clients, at all levels of the organization.
* Guides business leaders on HR policies and processes, including talent reviews, learning and development, and performance management to promote engagement and a culture of continuous growth and development.
* Translates business strategies into people and organizational priorities. Leads the discussion with the business leadership teams in applying and aligning people and organizational priorities with organization vision and execution, to achieve the business goals for an assigned client.
* Assesses career progression and promotion criteria of the workforce, develops skills inventory by role and employee development needs based on business strategy to help close gaps between current and future skill sets.
* Plans and leads organization design projects to streamline and implement new structures, roles and/or processes that create speed, efficiency, and support rapidly shifting business demands.
* Works closely with management and employees to coach and improve work relationships, build morale, and increase productivity and retention.
* Champions a return to office environment and assists with lifting onsite culture and collaboration.
* Provide guidance on people and organizational issues: Employee relations, Talent Management, Succession planning, Performance Management and HR strategic initiatives.
* Develops thoughtful, integrated approaches to promote diversity, equity and inclusion in talent attraction, development and retention.
* Plans and facilitates leader alignment sessions, new leader assimilation sessions, strategy deployment work sessions with a goal to develop business strategies (i.e. vision, mission, value, objectives) that help support organizational focus, efficiency, speed, and business results.
* Lead partner with talent acquisition, with a strong focus on acquiring and retaining top talent and on building pipeline for future needs.
* Provide HR analytics to assist leadership with the decision-making process and to understand trends on hiring, attraction, compensation, structure design, etc.
* Play an active leadership role in the commitment to continuous improvement and be perceived as credible and capable of leading organization effectiveness across the business.

**Qualifications for success**

  

* 10-12 years of experience in an HR Business Partner Role, preferably in a global company or professional services industry. This role may or may not manage a team in the future.
* Proven ability to diagnose problems using strategic hinking skills as well as identify and drive appropriate solutions.
* History of successfully delivering against people agendas.
* Demonstrated ability to work in and manage ambiguity – dealing with issues that do not always have a process or a system in place.
* Ability to position self as credible (garners respect, acts with integrity, keeps commitments); proactive (has a point of view, challenges assumptions, takes initiative); and a trusted thought partner (builds relationships, delivers results).
* Demonstrated experience and ability to balance business partnering skills with employee advocacy.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with constant change and adaptability.
* Background reflecting a strong tenure and career progression within a complex, global organization.
* Ability to lead and manage complex projects with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong project management skills, business acumen, Excel spreadsheet, and PowerPoint capability.
* English fluency required
* Must be able to report onsite to our Bangalore office 3 days per week.

**What you can expect from Optiv**

* A company committed to our inclusive value through our Employee Resource Groups
* Work/life balance
* Professional training resources
* Creative problem-solving and the ability to tackle unique, complex projects
* Volunteer Opportunities. “Optiv Chips In” encourages employees to volunteer and engage with their teams and communities.
* The ability and technology necessary to productively work remotely/from home (where applicable)

  ### **5. Technical & Functional Troubleshooting**

  Analyze and resolve VIM workflow and invoice processing issues.Debug invoice processing errors and determine root causes.Work closely with SAP ABAP developers on enhancements and custom developments.Analyze application logs, workflow logs, and interface errors.Support performance optimization and system stability.Coordinate with SAP Basis, ABAP, MM, FI, and OpenText technical teams.

  Conduct business requirement workshops and fit-gap analysis.Prepare functional specifications and solution design documents.Lead functional testing, integration testing, and UAT.Manage defect resolution and production deployments.Provide guidance and mentoring to junior consultants.Coordinate with business users, finance teams, and technical stakeholders.Support production operations and continuous improvement initiatives.
